subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: The Capital One Breach
description: A fast breakdown of The Capital One Breach for builders.

hook.text: A former Amazon employee exploited a firewall flaw to steal 106 million Capital One credit applications.

buildup.text: The stolen data included Social Security numbers, bank accounts, credit scores, and addresses.

discovery.text: The hacker bragged about the breach on social media, which is how the FBI caught her.

twist.text: Capital One stored data on AWS — the cloud service run by her former employer, Amazon.

climax.text: A single misconfigured firewall exposed 106 million people. The cloud is only as safe as its settings.

punchline.text: One firewall flaw. 106 million records gone.

quiz.question: How was the Capital One hacker caught?
options: She bragged about the breach on social media
An automated security system flagged the intrusion
